base_member_text: [L130] (MED/configuration-path) The netcdf_Release|x64 configuration writes object files to bin\win32\$(ConfigurationName) while its output/module paths are bin\x64, mixing architectures/configuration directories.
[L163] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_netcdf_Debug|x64 uses bin\win32\$(ConfigurationName) for ModulePath and ObjectFile despite being an x64 configuration, causing cross-configuration artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L130,L163] (MED/configuration-contamination) Several x64 configurations write objects or modules into Win32 output directories, creating architecture collisions.

adversarial.rationale: The IFX project repeats the explicit Win32 object destination for netcdf_Release|x64 and Win32 module/object/PDB destinations for MPI_netcdf_Debug|x64. Inspection of all file entries, configuration attributes and solution mappings found no override redirecting those compiler outputs to x64.

base_member_text: [L152] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_Release|x64 searches ..\xbeachlibrary\bin\static\$(ConfigurationName) for the library include directory instead of the x64 path used elsewhere in that configuration.
audit_member_text: [L152] (MED/missing-include-path) MPI_Release|x64 omits the x64 component from its static-library module search path.

base_member_text: [L74-L86,L162-L174] (MED/configuration-contract) The MPI_netcdf configurations contain no PreprocessorDefinitions for USEMPI or USENETCDF, unlike the separate MPI and netcdf configurations, so their names do not match the feature flags they appear intended to enable.
audit_member_text: [L75,L86,L163,L174] (MED/feature-configuration) Combined MPI_netcdf configurations enable preprocessing but omit MPI and netCDF definitions, unlike the corresponding static-library builds.

adversarial.rationale: The IFX executable has the same three unconditional wrapper sources as the classic project, so preprocessing does not consume these feature definitions in this project. Its static-library dependency supplies feature selection and explicitly enables both flags in xbeachlibrary_IFX.vfproj:75,86,163,174; omission in the executable is not a functional configuration defect.
